purpose: Improve the information each past event contributes inside the encoder, conditional on the current state, before aggregating events.
hypothesis: A history record can require a different channel-wise transformation for different current contexts; scalar retrieval weights over fixed values may not express that interaction efficiently.
hypothesis_status: untested; current experiments do not establish fixed values as the cause of failure
baseline: fresh TitanTPP B with two encoder blocks and original static Hard-LMM

architecture.insertion: inside the second encoder attention block, before its existing residual and feed-forward path
architecture.input: u_i is the existing second-block pre-attention normalized first-block hidden state
architecture.weights: w_ij is the head mean of existing second-attention probabilities before attention dropout; use only observed causal event columns j<=i; exclude persistent token columns without renormalizing remaining mass
architecture.candidate: c_i = sum_j w_ij * (2*sigmoid(q_i+k_j) elementwise-multiplied by v_j)
architecture.injection: add U c_i to the existing attention output, then preserve the original residual, feed-forward, static Hard-LMM and shared time/quantity state
architecture.zero_cases: no observed event mass or an unobserved query gives exactly zero correction
architecture.causality: exclude future, padding and unobserved records; sanitize invalid features before nonlinear transforms
architecture.state_lifetime: per-forward causal history only; no persistent cross-batch state
architecture.training: all original and added parameters jointly trainable; no new dropout, detach, task split, auxiliary loss or dataset-specific thresholds

same_parameter_control.pooled_values: kbar_i = sum_j w_ij*k_j/s_i; vbar_i = sum_j w_ij*v_j/s_i
same_parameter_control.empty_branch: return zero without dividing by zero
same_parameter_control.controlled_difference: nonlinear query/event interaction before aggregation versus after aggregation
same_parameter_control.capacity: identical trainable tensor names/shapes and initial values; both routes use R,S,V,U
same_parameter_control.not_claimed: equal function class or equal runtime

initialization.R_S_V: standard Linear initialization inside fork_rng so added initialization does not consume caller RNG
initialization.base: identical common B parameters for the same seed
initialization.verification_required: initial outputs, objective and common-B pre-clipping gradients match B; same caller RNG
initialization.clipping_limit: Added U gradients enter total gradient clipping, so the first clipped optimizer update need not equal B.

objective.planned: fresh B, control and candidate all use the same recorded-duration probability and existing log-MSE quantity objective
objective.attribution: Only compare fresh arms within this common condition; historical legacy-time runs are context, not controls for the new architecture effect.

distinction_from_previous_candidates.difference: Those candidates change reads and add corrections after the base encoder; this candidate changes each event message inside the encoder while retaining one joint representation.

Broadly related nonlinear-before-pooling family, but previous values transformed query-independent successor time/quantity features; this design transforms hidden event vectors conditional on each query inside attention.
Those modify address/score geometry; this design keeps existing scalar attention probabilities and adds channel-wise message transformation.
Prior negative first-order linear probe results neither validate nor directly rule out this nonlinear pairwise operation.
Already represented in prior project implementations; not presented as a new direction here.

cost.pairwise_compute: O(batch*sequence_length^2*r) in addition to projection work
cost.caveat: Autograd may retain several tensors; this is not peak GPU memory. Chunked implementation must match dense forward and gradients.
cost.measurement: actual forward/backward time and memory at lengths64/256 before fixing a GPU budget

verification_required: Scalar oracle distinguishing the two nonlinear aggregation orders; q=0, w=(0.5,0.5), k=(-2,2), v=(-1,1) gives candidate=tanh(1), control=0.
One record, equal event keys and zero event mass reduce consistently to the control.
B initial output/objective/common gradient/RNG equivalence and identical base parameters.
Strict future-target/padding/mask-gap causality and batch independence.
After activating U, gradients reach R,S,V,U and the base encoder from both prediction objectives.
No recomputation of stochastic attention; exposing pre-dropout weights preserves existing dropout draws.
Saved routing identity, model/optimizer/RNG/selector restoration and next-update equality.
Shared runner identical batches, strict earliest raw-RMSE selection and same-checkpoint metrics.
decision_rule_for_next_stage: Implementation must pass the causal, gradient, initialization and restore contracts and have a measured feasible cost. Performance gates must be frozen before GPU runs; no improvement or novelty claim follows from these engineering checks.
future_artifacts: synthetic CPU verification and cost receipt
